Name: Stardrop Cantina
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]Welcome to the Stardrop Cantina! Would you like some blue milk?

This is just a silly little mod I thought up. This mod replaces the Saloon music with the Mos Eisley Cantina music from the original Star Wars. Gus also has a new menu item...blue milk! 

Usual install instructions, just download, drag and drop into your Mod folder.

Enjoy!
